description: List Central Command x402 catalog endpoints (names, prices, parameters, tiers). Purpose: discover which cc.* tools exist and what they cost before calling them. Behavior: READ-ONLY. Does not place orders or charge per-endpoint fees by itself (catalog fetch). Auth: optional X-Api-Key (same catalog is public); payment not required for listing. Cost: free to list. Individual endpoint calls are billed separately when invoked. Rate limit: gateway default. Returns: JSON envelope { ok, endpoint, status, data: { endpoints: [...] } }. Guidelines: Call this first. Then invoke cc.<slug> with required params. Admin-only tools are omitted.
name: cc.list_catalog

outputSchema.description: x402 catalog listing used to discover tools and prices.
